name: mf_fno_selfdistill
description: Transfer-learning MF-FNO (pretrain LF -> fine-tune HF; Lyu 2023) with FiLM-on-X conditioning and FIDELITY BOOTSTRAPPING. After LF pretrain, the LF-pretrained model predicts PSEUDO-HF labels on the LF inputs; HF finetune then trains on a MIX of the few real HF samples (weight 1.0) and the pseudo-HF samples (weight pseudo_weight<1.0) via per-sample weighted MSE, so scarce real HF data dominates while pseudo labels expand input-space coverage. extra reports n_real_hf, n_pseudo_hf, pseudo_weight. Only the data/schedule differs from the frozen FiLM winner.
